description: Public Print and Fill geometry mutation probes for registered infill overhang angle and crosszag shift-step behavior.

mutants.description: Hardwire the lateral honeycomb ridge slope to 60 degrees. The public Fill geometry fixture at the registered 15 and 75 degree endpoints must move from the lower-angle single-family lattice phase to the upper-angle two-family phase.
mutants.old: const float vertical_period = 3 * half_horizontal_period / tanf(degree * float(params.infill_overhang_angle));

mutants.description: Hardwire the PrintRegionConfig overhang angle at the real Print-to-Fill forwarding site. The sliced 20 x 20 x 1.6 mm lateral-honeycomb fixture retains its 15/75 degree region-config checks and requires the 75 degree print to emit at least three more long vertical infill tracks than the 15 degree print on layers 1 (Z=0.4 mm) and 4 (Z=1.0 mm).
Drop the configured shift on even crosszag layer pairs. The maximum 10 mm setting must change the measured emitted phase on layer 2 by the configured amount modulo measured line pitch.
Drop the configured shift on odd crosszag layer pairs. The maximum 10 mm setting must change the measured emitted phase on layer 3 by the opposite local-normal amount modulo measured line pitch.
